title: CypressError: cy.findByText() failed because it requires the subject be a global 'document' object.
body:
- `cypress-testing-library` version: 5.2.0 - `node` version: 13.7.0 - `npm` (or `yarn`) version: 6.13.6 Relevant code or config ```javascript it('should validate the credentials', () => { cy.findByText(/Log me in/i) .click() .findByText(/Username should not be empty/i) .findByText(/Password should not be empty/i); }); ``` What you did: Bump @testing-library/cypress from 5.0.2 to 5.2.0 What happened: 
  1) Register page should validate the data:                                                                                                                                                                                      [149/2152]
     CypressError: cy.findByText() failed because it requires the subject be a global 'document' object.
